name: zabbix/zabbix-frontend-php8-migration
description: Test-only Composer manifest for the Zabbix 5.0.47 ui/ PHP8 compatibility migration. This project does NOT use Composer to run the frontend itself: production code is still loaded exclusively through the existing hand-rolled CAutoloader (include/classes/core/CAutoloader.php, registered by ZBase::initAutoloader()), which this file does not touch or replace in any way. This manifest exists solely to install PHPUnit for the tests under ui/tests/.
